PROGRAMS.intro: Digital Shakti is the power to learn, grow and help your company grow — digitally. In plain language and with hands-on practice, your team learns to use smartphones, computers, WhatsApp Business, social media and everyday apps like professionals.
glance: On-site · Hands-on, phone-in-hand workshop with live demos and Q&A
Team members at every level — especially those less comfortable with technology
DG Trainings Certificate of Completion for every participant [Confirm]
PROGRAMS.overview_h: In a digital world, every employee needs digital power.
overview: A team that can’t share a professional PDF, update a WhatsApp catalogue or use a gold-rate app is slower, less professional and less competitive. Digital Shakti closes that gap — without jargon, and without anyone feeling left behind.

Every topic is taught on the participant’s own phone, with jewellery-business examples: organising design photos in albums, sending clean scanned documents, editing product pictures and selling through social media.
highlights: Smartphone mastery — Android and iOS basics, productivity and time tools
Jewellery-business apps — live spot-rate apps, IIJS and GJEPC, news
Look professional — PDF converter, document scanner, photo editing, DigiLocker, password manager
Safe digital payments — bank apps and UPI
Computer basics, Zoom, WhatsApp Web and ChatGPT
Instagram, Facebook and YouTube — posting, reels, business pages and engagement
WhatsApp Business — catalogue, quick replies, labels, broadcasts — and Google My Business
modules: The importance of digital knowledge today and the cost of falling behind.
What makes a phone smart; Android and iOS; Google Calendar, clock, notes and to-do lists; favourites; organising photos into albums for jewellery designs.
News apps; IIJS and GJEPC apps; live spot-rate apps for gold and silver; video conferencing.
Photo-to-PDF; document scanning; photo editing for jewellery pictures; file transfer; password manager; DigiLocker.
Bank apps and UPI step by step; benefits and safety of online payments; booking bus, train and flight tickets.
What a computer is and does; getting started; WhatsApp Web; joining a Zoom meeting; introduction to ChatGPT.
Instagram (posting, stories, reels, business account, insights); Facebook (pages, groups, Marketplace); YouTube (shorts, uploading, getting views); creating engaging content.
Groups, broadcasts, status and power features; business profile, catalogue, short links, greeting and away messages, quick replies, labels; do’s and don’ts.
What it is and how reviews and ratings bring customers to your store.
attend: Sales, counter, back-office and karigar teams who use phones daily
Senior staff who want to become confident with technology
Owners who want the whole team digitally ready
outcomes: Faster, more professional communication with customers and vendors
Active, well-managed WhatsApp Business and social profiles
Safer use of payments, passwords and documents
A team that is confident — not afraid — of technology
PROGRAMS.method: Hands-on on participants’ own phones · Step-by-step screenshots and tutorial videos · Q&A after every section · Plain, simple language
PROGRAMS.impact: Simple before/after skill checks and live tasks — e.g., set up a WhatsApp catalogue, share a scanned PDF, post a reel.
PROGRAMS.trainer_bio: Working with businesses since 2000 and training teams since 2011, with 35,000+ professionals trained across 20 cities in 3 countries. Dedicated to the jewellery industry, DG brings real retail, wholesale and manufacturing experience to every session — making technology simple and useful for every jewellery business.
faqs: Our staff have very basic phone knowledge. Will they be able to learn?
Absolutely — the program is designed for beginners and moves at a comfortable pace with lots of practice.
Do participants need laptops?
A smartphone is enough for most modules. The computer module needs a few laptops or desktops at the venue. [Confirm]
Will employees get practical training?
Yes. Employees learn step by step how to use digital tools and apps for everyday tasks.
PROGRAMS.cta_h: Give your team the power of digital.
PROGRAMS.cta_text: Book a session and make your whole team digitally confident — in days, not months.

PROGRAMS.name: Orientation Training
PROGRAMS.tagline: The right start, from day one.
PROGRAMS.card: Customised to give every new joiner detailed information about your company, its products, services and code of conduct — and to introduce them to your key members and work culture.
PROGRAMS.focus: Company & product knowledge · Code of conduct · Jewellery business basics · Culture
PROGRAMS.intro: A new employee’s first few days shape how they connect with your organisation and contribute to its success. Orientation Training gives every new joiner a structured introduction to your company, its people, policies and customer promise — aligning them with business goals and helping them contribute to growth from day one.
glance: On-site at your showroom or office · Customised induction presentation built for your company, delivered by DG Trainings [Confirm]
New joiners across all departments — sales, back office, accounts, production and support
DG Trainings Certificate of Completion for every participant [Confirm]
overview: When new joiners learn the company in bits and pieces from whoever is nearby, they pick up half-truths, unclear rules and old habits. When they’re welcomed properly, they understand the brand, respect the systems and settle in faster.

We work with your management and HR to build a branded induction program around your company — your history, leaders, products, presence, organisation structure and policies — written in simple, friendly language and delivered so that every new joiner hears the same, correct message.
highlights: A complete, branded induction program built around your company
Your story, mission, vision and values — told in a way that builds pride
Leadership, team, presence and business explained clearly
Every key policy explained simply — work hours, leave, salary, promotion, grievance, travel
Code of conduct, dress code and customer promise — the standards everyone follows
Benefits and perks presented so employees value what they receive
One consistent message for every new joiner, in every branch
modules: Your journey: when and where it began, key milestones, customers served and what makes you different.
Where the company is going, why it exists, and the core values every employee lives by — with simple examples of each.
Founders, leadership team, departments, key contacts and reporting structure.
Products, brands, showrooms, manufacturing units, markets, new launches and essential product knowledge.
Workplace expectations, professional conduct, confidentiality, company assets and ethical behaviour.
Shift timings, breaks, punctuality, weekly offs, leave types and application procedures.
Salary cycle, loans and advances, incentives, benefits, probation, confirmation, appraisals, promotions and increments.
Raising concerns, complaint procedures and the appropriate channels for resolution.
Official travel, expense claims, uniforms, grooming and professional presentation.
Customer service standards, showroom etiquette, customer trust and the do’s and don’ts of customer engagement.
attend: Every new joiner, in their first week
Existing employees who need a refresher on policies and standards
Companies opening new branches or hiring in large batches
PROGRAMS.outcomes_h: What changes with a proper induction
outcomes: New joiners settle in faster and contribute sooner
Fewer policy misunderstandings and HR queries
Stronger pride and loyalty from day one — lower early attrition
The same values, rules and customer standards across every branch

PROGRAMS.impact: Track early attrition (first 90 days), time to productivity and new-joiner feedback — before and after a structured induction.
PROGRAMS.trainer_bio: Working with businesses since 2000 and training teams since 2011, with 35,000+ professionals trained across 20 cities in 3 countries. Dedicated to the jewellery industry, DG brings real retail, wholesale and manufacturing experience to every session — and is an expert in building the culture that new joiners step into.
faqs: Will the induction be about our company or generic?
Entirely about your company. We build it from your story, leaders, products, structure and policies.
What information will be required from us?
Your company history, leadership details, organisation chart, policies and a few photos. We handle the writing and design.
Can we include department-specific information in the program?
Yes. Relevant roles, reporting structures and departmental responsibilities can be incorporated into the program.
Do you also cover culture and soft skills?
Orientation covers the company and its rules. For mindset, habits and culture, pair it with Life & Work Culture Transformation.
PROGRAMS.cta_h: Give every new joiner the right start.
PROGRAMS.cta_text: Book a free discovery call — we’ll build an induction program that makes your company proud and your people productive from day one.
